messages:
sara: quick proposal for a 'momentum gate' for q4v2 quant bring-up. aim = reduce oscillation from brief noisy lifts.

noah: high level ok. what's the main rule?

sara: compute per-minute relative delta on concordance, clamp extremes, take EWMA of those deltas as momentum. require momentum > 0.02 for 40m to promote. immediate rollback if any 10m window shows absolute drop < -0.04 or latency_p95 > 130ms.

cheng: add low-QPS fallback? min_samples 300 might never hit on some routes.

sara: yes fallback: for routes with avg_per_min_samples < 50, multiply sustained duration by 4. also ignore minutes with sample_count < 8.

noah: can we get a tiny config snippet to slot into the rollout engine?

sara: pasted a minimal sketch to the runbook: gate=momentum, metric=concordance_v2, clamp=[-0.2,0.2], per_min_cap=0.06, ewma_alpha=0.12, promote_momentum=0.02,duration_mins=40, rollback_abs_lt=-0.04, rollback_window_mins=10, latency_p95_lt=130, ramp=1%->5% steps.

ops-bot: note: scheduled shadow run queued for 2026-04-10T02:00Z job rbu-shadow-6370. reminder set 24h prior to #eng-oncall.

cheng: test plan: shadow 48h vs control q4v2-nf4, collect concordance by seqlen buckets and prompt type. tiny-burn 72h: 1% start, steps 5% every 12h to 20% if gates pass. final promote after 7d stable with no sustained negative momentum > 0.02.

sara: tagging @noah @cheng for watch. will post the runbook + quick revert CLI in ~30m. :thumbsup:
